content.text: /ext:medcp How many breast cancer patients are currently active in our records?
I'll check the clinical records database for breast cancer patients.

This is an OMOP CDM database. Breast cancer conditions map to SNOMED concept 4112853 ("Malignant tumor of breast") and its descendants. "Currently active" means the patient has an open observation period (no end, or end in the future). Let me query.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS active_breast_cancer_patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.observation_period op
  ON co.person_id = op.person_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4112853
  AND op.observation_period_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE;

arguments.sql_query:

FROM omop.condition_occurrence co

content.text: The zero result is suspicious — likely the data is historical, so no observation periods extend to today's date. Let me verify whether there are any breast cancer patients at all and check the date range of the data.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS total_breast_cancer_patients,
  MIN(op.observation_period_end_date) AS min_op_end,
  MAX(op.observation_period_end_date) AS max_op_end
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
LEFT JOIN omop.observation_period op
  ON co.person_id = op.person_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4112853;

The data confirms it: **48,153** patients have a breast cancer diagnosis, but all observation periods end in late Feb 2026 (max `2026-02-26`), so none extend to today. My original "active" query returned 0 for that reason, not because there are no such patients.

A caveat on "currently active": this dataset's observation periods end around 2026-02-24 to 2026-02-26, so no patient is technically "active as of today" (2026-07-23). FROM omop.condition_occurrence co

LEFT JOIN omop.death d
  ON co.person_id = d.person_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4112853
  AND d.person_id IS NULL;
